svg.title: Подъём гантелей T лёжа на скамье — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. PRONE BENCH T-RAISE with TWO light DUMBBELLS. Elevated rear three-quarter view. Both figures lie FACE DOWN, chest/belly/hips supported on a FLAT horizontal bench, legs extended with feet on floor behind. Head beyond bench end. Left: both arms hang down toward floor, each hand holds dumbbell. Right: both straightish arms extend directly OUT TO THE SIDES, PERPENDICULAR to torso into letter T, level with shoulders, not forward overhead into Y. Chest remains touching bench. Entire bench and its legs visible. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
